items.briefing:
Australian regulators have flagged that home battery systems — including solar storage — are now considered a cybersecurity compliance concern, as connected energy devices can be exploited to disrupt power networks. This is worth noting for any staff who use these systems at home or if your organisation has them on-site. Separately, ongoing scam activity continues to target Australians, so remain cautious of unexpected messages asking for personal details or payments.

OpenAI has recently added stronger user controls to its platforms, a reminder that AI tools your organisation uses may update their settings — it's worth reviewing your privacy and data-sharing configurations periodically.

**Tip:** Check the privacy settings on any AI tools you use for work and ensure sensitive information isn't being shared or stored unnecessarily.
